title: sorbus latifolia
intro: Sorbus latifolia, commonly known as the broad-leaved rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The health benefits of Sorbus latifolia include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus latifolia include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, fever, and skin conditions, with its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, contributing to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus latifolia, including kaempferol, quercetin, and isorhapontigenin, have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
